name: AnimatedRotation
description: A widget that automatically animates changes in its rotation angle over a given duration and curve. Useful for smoothly rotating a child widget without manually using an AnimationController.

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree to rotate.

properties.name: turns
properties.description: The number of complete rotations to apply to the child. 1.0 equals a full 360-degree rotation.
properties.possible_values: Any double, e.g., 0.5 for 180 degrees, 1.0 for 360 degrees

properties.name: alignment
properties.description: The alignment around which to rotate the child.
properties.possible_values: Any Alignment, e.g., Alignment.topLeft, Alignment.center, Alignment.bottomRight

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate rotation changes.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating rotation.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut
